name: Diltiazem
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.effect: Higher ivabradine exposure; worse bradycardia and conduction disturbances (label).
Diltiazem levels fell to undetectable with rifampin (label).
key_interactions.action: Avoid when possible; consider alternative therapy.

key_interactions.effect: Additive AV-conduction slowing; propranolol levels up about 50% (label).

key_interactions.action: Monitor digoxin when starting, adjusting or stopping diltiazem.

key_interactions.effect: Cyclosporine dose cut of 15 to 48% needed in transplant patients (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor cyclosporine levels when starting, adjusting or stopping diltiazem.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Statins metabolized by CYP3A4 (simvastatin, lovastatin, atorvastatin)
key_interactions.effect: Higher statin levels; myopathy and rhabdomyolysis (label).
key_interactions.action: Prefer a statin not metabolized by CYP3A4; otherwise adjust doses and monitor.

key_interactions.effect: Carbamazepine levels up 40 to 72%, with toxicity in some cases (label).
Benzodiazepine exposure up 3- to 4-fold; buspirone up 5.5-fold (label).

key_interactions.action: Monitor and adjust the diltiazem dose.
